title: Understanding Cross-Entropy Loss
text: Cross-entropy loss measures the difference between the actual and predicted probabilities. For each data point, if the actual label is $$0$$, the loss is -log(1-predicted probability). If the actual label is $$1$$, the loss is -log(predicted probability).

title: Calculate Individual Losses
text: For the first row, the actual label is $$0$$ and the predicted probability is $$0.45$$. Calculate the loss using $$-\ln\left(1-0.45\right)$$.

title: Calculate Mean Loss
text: Once you have the individual losses for each row, find the mean by summing them up and dividing by the number of rows, which is $$3$$ in this case.
